mechanism: Adalimumab (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk and can impair immune response, while phenelzine (MAOI) may further compromise immune function and increase risk of hypertensive crisis if combined with certain sympathomimetic effects of infection/inflammation.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection and hypertensive episodes; consider alternative antidepressant class if possible, as MAOIs are generally avoided with immunosuppressive agents.
